name: diagnose
context_rationale: The orchestrating skill must hold pass-template content in memory, manage the sequential Agent-spawn loop, invoke write_pass.py after each subagent returns, and run assemble.py — all requiring the parent conversation's tool access and cwd context.
summary: Produces a single self-contained interactive HTML diagnosis of a target codebase for the repo owner. Runs 11 analysis passes (10 general-purpose subagents plus one cross-reference pass) via code-review-graph-backed code graph analysis, then spawns the diagnose-narrator named subagent for the executive summary, and assembles everything via assemble.py. The deliverable is diagnose-out/diagnosis.html, which embeds findings as JSON for owner annotation. Never modifies source files in the target repo.

agents.when: Step 6.5 — after all 11 forensic passes have written their YAMLs and summaries
agents.purpose: Writes the executive summary (sections/00-overview.md) from findings/*.yaml and summary/*.md using fresh context

methodology_tools.name: write_pass
methodology_tools.purpose: Orchestrator-side writer: parse each subagent's 4-backtick fenced section/findings/summary blocks, normalize + validate findings, write the three per-pass files. SHARED in scripts/lib/ (used by /bug-hunt too).

methodology_tools.name: assemble
methodology_tools.purpose: Compose diagnose-out/diagnosis.html from per-pass artifacts; runs the shared finding_dedup after load + carries over prior annotations. SHARED in scripts/lib/ (used by /bug-hunt too).

name: bug-hunt
context_rationale: Orchestrator: risk-ranks the codebase, holds the work-list in memory, runs the sequential finder Agent-spawn loop, invokes write_pass.py / finding_dedup.py / assemble.py between subagents, spawns code-review refuters, and makes the interactive (declinable) /repro+/slice handoff offers — all requiring the parent conversation's tool access and cwd.
summary: Whole-codebase correctness + security defect sweep. Risk-ranks the riskiest code via code-review-graph, fans out intent-aware finder subagents along the code-review 9 dimensions (multi-finder, not one-shot), de-duplicates across finders via the shared finding_dedup, then adversarially verifies every candidate with code-review refuters (majority vote for high/critical) so confirmed bugs survive and false positives are killed. Fills the whole-codebase DEFECT cell that /diagnose (structural) and /code-review (diff-scoped) leave empty. Emits bug-hunt-out/findings.json (+ optional --report diagnosis.html via the shared assemble.py) and offers a declinable /repro -> /slice handoff for confirmed bugs. Never modifies source files.

agents.name: code-review
agents.when: Step 7 — adversarial verification of each merged candidate finding
agents.purpose: Refuter persona: reads the cited code and votes real|not-real|uncertain (defaulting to not-real when it cannot reproduce the failing path); 3 refuters + majority for high/critical, single refuter for medium/low. The same code-Critic persona reused as the finder lens.

methodology_tools.name: finding_dedup
methodology_tools.purpose: Cross-finder de-duplication: collapse findings sharing a code location (path + line span) into one F-MRG-* finding carrying merged_ids/seen_by_passes/categories. Shared with /diagnose (assemble.py).

methodology_tools.name: write_pass
methodology_tools.purpose: Orchestrator-side writer: parse each finder subagent's fenced section/findings/summary blocks, normalize + validate findings, write the three per-bucket files. SHARED in scripts/lib/ (same module /diagnose uses).

methodology_tools.name: assemble
methodology_tools.purpose: Render the optional owner-facing HTML report from the verified findings (only under --report). SHARED in scripts/lib/ (same module /diagnose uses); already runs the shared finding_dedup internally.

methodology_tools.name: vault_edit
methodology_tools.purpose: SVW-1 safe append of an accepted bug finding into <vault>/candidates.json (source type bug-hunt-finding) on a declinable /repro+/slice handoff.
